overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long SK Hynix Daily ETF (SKHX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the ADR SK Hynix Inc. stock, less fees and expenses SKHX was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.

data.title: Themes ETFs Goes Live on SK Hynix as One of AI's Marquee IPOs Hits the Tape
data.text: Newly launched SKHX and SKHZ hand active traders a timely, cost-efficient way to play SK Hynix from either direction as shares begin changing hands. GREENWICH, Conn.
